name: Washington

flag.description: A dark green field with the state seal in the center: a portrait of George Washington inside a gold ring reading "The Seal of the State of Washington 1889".
flag.symbolism: The green stands for the Evergreen State's forests, and the portrait honors the president the state is named after.

hook: Washington is the only green state flag, with George Washington's face looking out from the middle.
trivia: Washington's is the only US state flag with a green field.
It is also the only state flag to show the portrait of a US president.
